iso29148.name: ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148:2011
iso29148.description: Systems and software engineering — Life cycle processes — Requirements engineering

rules.validation: Each requirement shall have a unique identifier that is used consistently across all project documentation
Each requirement shall describe a single capability or constraint
Each requirement shall be verifiable through inspection, demonstration, test, or analysis
Each requirement shall be traceable to higher-level requirements or other source documentation
Each requirement shall have only one possible interpretation

rules.description: Requirements must use 'shall' for mandatory requirements
rules.validation: Mandatory requirements shall use the word 'shall'
Requirements shall not specify design solutions unless necessary as a constraint

rules.description: Data privacy requirements must be defined
rules.validation: Requirements shall specify how personal data is collected, processed, stored, and protected

rules.description: Data retention periods must be specified
rules.validation: Requirements shall specify how long personal data will be retained and when it will be deleted

rules.description: Data subject rights must be addressed
rules.validation: Requirements shall address data subject rights including access, rectification, erasure, and portability
Requirements shall specify the creation and maintenance of an audit trail for all financial data
Requirements shall document security controls for financial reporting systems
Requirements shall specify security controls for protecting information assets

rules.description: Access control requirements must be defined
rules.validation: Requirements shall specify access control measures for information systems

rules.description: Incident response procedures must be defined
rules.validation: Requirements shall define procedures for responding to security incidents

critical.description: Critical compliance issue that must be addressed immediately

high.description: High severity compliance issue that should be addressed soon

medium.description: Medium severity compliance issue that should be addressed

low.description: Low severity compliance issue that should be noted

compliance_summary.description: Overview of compliance status for all requirements

detailed_compliance.description: Detailed analysis of compliance with specific standards

non_compliance.description: List of all non-compliant items with remediation suggestions

audit_trail.description: Comprehensive audit log for a specified time period

compliance_violation.body: A compliance violation has been detected for rule {rule_id}: {description}. Severity: {severity}.

audit_export.body: The audit log export requested by {user} has been completed. Time period: {start_date} to {end_date}.
